With that in mind
Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Travelers must keep companion animals calm, contained, and ready for inspection before check-in. Please follow staff directions closely so boarding remains safe for you, your animal, and nearby travelers.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways handles companion animal travel with care and discipline. Handlers use humane methods and adjust support to the species, temperament, and comfort of each animal. If an animal shows distress, report it at once and do not improvise with feed, leash, or carrier changes.

Staff note: <<FACT F111>> Please keep carriers secure, labels clear, and documents available when requested. Delays usually come from missing papers or poor preparation, not from routine review.

For guidance on carrier fit, animal comfort, or cabin concerns, speak directly with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you proceed to the gate.
